intent.proves: At least one visible Create user app is placed on an active page.
intent.scope: active UserCreate paragraphs on active pages (Extranet create mode not counted)

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Paragraph p JOIN Page g ON g.PageId = p.ParagraphPageId WHERE p.ParagraphDeleted = 0 AND p.ParagraphShowParagraph = 1 AND g.PageDeleted = 0 AND g.PageActive = 1 AND p.ParagraphModuleSystemName = 'UserCreate'
